column1: HUMAN EVALUATION SHEET — Physics Cascade System
ICCCMLA 2026 — Answer Quality Assessment
INSTRUCTIONS FOR EVALUATORS
1. You will evaluate 30 physics questions.
2. For each question, read the question, options, and the SLM and/or Cloud answer.
3. Use YOUR OWN PHYSICS KNOWLEDGE to assign scores — do not look up answers.
4. Do NOT discuss with other evaluators — score independently.
5. The "Correct Answer" column is shown ONLY as a reference AFTER you score.
6. Fill in ONLY the columns marked "Human Score" based on the Category.
SCORING RUBRICS
GSS — Gap Severity Score (fill ONLY for MISSED questions)
Score 1 = Minor error — trivial mistake, student would likely self-correct
Score 2 = Moderate error — meaningful misconception, would confuse a student
Score 3 = Critical error — fundamentally wrong, would actively mislead a student
EVS — Escalation Value Score (fill ONLY for ESCALATED questions)
Score 0 = No value — cloud answer same quality as SLM answer
Score 1 = Marginal — minor improvement, not essential
Score 2 = Meaningful — clear correctness improvement over SLM
Score 3 = Critical — cloud answer essential, SLM was wrong or dangerously incomplete
EQS — Explanation Quality Score (fill ONLY for ESCALATED CONCEPTUAL questions)
Score 1 = Poor — no meaningful explanation provided
Score 2 = Basic — minimal explanation, hard to follow
Score 3 = Adequate — explains the concept sufficiently
Score 4 = Good — clear, accurate and well-structured explanation
Score 5 = Excellent — thorough, pedagogically strong, ideal for a student
SANITY CHECK questions — no scoring needed, just verify the answer makes sense
PHYSICS TOPICS COVERED
High School Physics — Class 11-12 level (CBSE/ISC equivalent)
Topics: Fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, waves, optics, electrostatics, mechanics
College Physics — First year undergraduate (BSc/BE level)
Topics: Circuits, modern physics, rotational mechanics
Conceptual Physics — Qualitative reasoning, no heavy calculation
Astronomy — Stellar physics, cosmology basics
IMPORTANT NOTES
- SLM = Small Language Model running on device (Gemma 3 1B, Gemma 3 4B, or Phi-3 Mini)
- Cloud = Claude Sonnet 4.5 (cloud validator)
- ESCALATED = SLM was uncertain, sent query to cloud for validation
- MISSED = SLM answered confidently but incorrectly, did NOT escalate to cloud
- CORRECT LOCAL = SLM answered correctly without escalating (sanity check only)
Thank you for your participation. Your scores will be used in a published IEEE paper.
Your name will NOT be published — only your general profile (physics educator).
